---
title: "Broad-beta status"
---

This edition is the **broad-beta release candidate** promised in the project brief. It contains 36 substantive chapters across the 12 original Parts, covers all 82 source topics, publishes all 53 practical resources, and provides 11 situation-based “I’m stuck” pathways.

## What has been completed

- the authoritative source brief is preserved privately and its SHA-256 hash is recorded;
- every original topic has a substantive destination in the handbook;
- all 36 chapters meet the broad-beta chapter contract and cite verified sources;
- all 53 checklists, decision aids and templates are substantive and rendered as book pages;
- priority resources include completed examples;
- the full-book search, left book contents, right page contents, previous/next navigation and mobile contents work in the rendered site;
- five documented coverage passes and two external-discovery passes have been completed;
- the contribution workflow keeps editorial approval with Haresh rather than permitting direct publication by readers; and
- automated verification checks chapter depth, citations, resources, internal links, image alternatives and rendered-page coverage.

## One owner-dependent item

An independent no-GitHub feedback form cannot be activated until Haresh supplies or approves its URL. This dependency is stated openly on the [suggestion page](contributions/index.qmd). It does not prevent readers from using the current guided GitHub suggestion forms, and it does not give contributors permission to edit the handbook directly.

## What broad beta means

Broad beta means the complete navigable handbook is available for use and review. It does not mean that advice is permanently complete or universal. Policies, technology and evidence change; local requirements must still be checked; and substantive corrections should flow through the documented editorial process.

The row-by-row requirements register is [`planning/requirements-checklist.csv`](https://github.com/hareshsuppiah/handbook-for-the-recently-enrolled/blob/main/planning/requirements-checklist.csv).
